behaviors_asserted: Bearer auth error responses are currently sent only as `application/json` or `text/plain`.
The middleware throws an `HTTPException` with a pre-built `res`, preventing an `onError` handler from fixing the headers afterwards.
Allow `MessageFunction` to return a `Response` and use that `Response` as-is (setting `WWW-Authenticate` if missing).
Alternatively, provide a `contentType` option next to `message`.
